usageNotes: Triggers a subscription status refresh on the specified PDM node, causing it to re-check its license key validity against the Proxmox subscription server. No request body parameters are accepted — the call itself is the trigger. Requires System.Modify on the system path; API tokens are supported.

examples.summary: Refresh subscription status on the local PDM node

tips: Returns null on success — a 200 with no body is the expected response; treat non-200 as failure.
Use 'localhost' as the node name when targeting the PDM host itself rather than a managed PVE node.
Run this after applying or changing a subscription key to force an immediate status update without waiting for the scheduled refresh.
